messages.author: c102ef7f5617067f
messages.subject: listen() gives error permission denied
parts:
If I try to play tico

data(tico)
listen(tico)

I get this error

/bin/sh: /var/folders/5v/mwpxjb1n6qzfqp9l9t99bbl80000gn/T//Rtmp7P9hID/tuneRtemp.wav: Permission denied


I tried this code:

library(sound)
setWavPlayer("/Applications/'QuickTime Player.app'/Contents/MacOS/'QuickTime Player'")

but problem persists. How can I get listen() to work?

Thanks
Ross

messages.author: e14cfb57d640984d
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] listen() gives error permission denied
parts:
Hi Ross,

The answer might depend on your operating system. It looks like you're on a Mac, but it's not clear which version. In any case, for some versions of OS X,  you can just do

library(tuneR)
setWavPlayer("afplay")

It's probably worth trying this.

best,
jesse
